status_copied: Copied · paste it in your chat app
status_not_sent_tap_again: Not sent · tap to share again
status_copied_toast: Copied. Paste it in your chat app
card_send_to: To {name} · paste it in your chat app
onboarding_tagline: Encrypted chats only the other person can read
onboarding_network_note: Text never touches the internet. Voice, photos and videos are encrypted, then relayed for up to 24 hours.
pairing_error_own_code: This is your own pairing code. Send it to the other person
intake_error_incomplete: That's not the whole encrypted message. Select all of it and try again
intake_error_no_contacts: You haven't added the sender yet
intake_error_cannot_decrypt: Can't decrypt. It may already be decrypted (check your chat), or it wasn't sent to you
intake_error_save_failed: Decrypted but couldn't save. Check your storage
intake_error_clipboard_empty: There's no text on the clipboard
intake_already_in_thread: This message is already in your chat
infoplist_camera_usage: Camera access is needed to scan pairing QR codes and to take photos and videos.
infoplist_microphone_usage: Microphone access is needed to record voice messages while you hold the button.
infoplist_photos_usage: Permission is needed to save images to your photo library.
media_failure_rate_limited: Too many sends. Try again later.
media_failure_too_large: This file is too large to send.
media_failure_file_missing: The file is missing and can't be uploaded.
media_failure_session_lost: Session lost. Add this contact again.
media_failure_read_failed: Couldn't read the encrypted file. Tap to retry.
media_status_not_visible: Not visible to them yet · tap to upload again
media_video_too_long: Videos can be up to 60 seconds.
media_awaiting_stalled: File not received yet · tap to retry
thread_unsupported_message: New message type. Update {app} to view it.
media_photos_write_denied: Allow {app} to save to Photos in Settings.
media_error_mixed_kinds: Internal error: mixed media types. Sending canceled.
media_voice_release_send_or_cancel: Release to send · slide up to cancel
media_mic_needed_body: Allow {app} to use the microphone in Settings to send voice messages.
media_camera_needed: Camera access is needed to take photos or videos.
media_no_camera: No camera is available on this device
media_picker_unreadable: Couldn't read the selected photo or video
thread_empty_send: Type or hold to talk. Encrypt, then paste it in your chat app.
thread_empty_receive: Got an encrypted message? Copy the whole message in your chat app, come back to {app} and tap “Paste”
pairing_show_hint_invite: Send this invite image to them. They long-press it to add you.
pairing_show_hint_response: Send this reply image back to them. Once they scan it, you're connected
pairing_qr_caption: Face to face? They can scan this.
pairing_enter_hint: Paste the pairing code they sent, or scan the QR code on their screen.
pairing_waiting_for_peer: When they send the reply image back, long-press it and scan the QR code to finish in {app}. You can leave this screen.
pairing_error_submit: Couldn't add. Check the code and try again.
pairing_error_gone: This pairing code no longer exists. Start again from Contacts.
pairing_error_no_matching_invite: This invite has already been used or deleted. Each invite adds one person — send them a new one.
pairing_error_is_message: This is an encrypted message, not a pairing code.
pairing_error_not_pairing: This isn't a {app} pairing code. Check it and try again.
pairing_delete_body: They'll still have your code, but you won't be able to finish adding them when they send theirs back. You'll need to start again.
pairing_scan_aim: Point the camera at their QR code
pairing_scan_no_camera: Camera access is needed to scan. You can go back and paste the code instead.
verify_explain_compare: Meet or call them and compare these 8 symbols.
verify_explain_meaning: If they match, no one is impersonating them.
verify_name_label: Give them a name (only you can see it)
verify_mismatch_body: Someone may have intercepted the pairing. Continuing deletes this contact and its local chat history; you'll need to add them again.
verify_no_code: No safety code yet. Add the contact again to create one.
conversations_empty_no_contacts: Add a contact to start your first encrypted chat.
conversations_empty_has_contacts: Still connecting. They'll show up here once you're connected — check progress in Contacts.
contacts_pending_response_unsent: Your code hasn't been sent back
contacts_resend_code_hint: They need to scan the pairing image you sent before they can get your messages.
contacts_clear_row_hint: Clear your local chat history with them
contacts_clear_body: This deletes all local messages with them.
contacts_delete_row_hint: Delete the contact, session keys, and local messages
contacts_delete_body: This deletes the contact and its local chat history. You'll need to add them again.
onboarding_step_encrypt: Send — write in {app}, encrypt, then paste it into your chat app
onboarding_step_send: Receive messages and invites — long-press to copy the whole message in your chat app
me_name_subtitle: Shown to people when you add each other
me_name_limit: Names have a length limit; typing stops when it's full
me_avatar_too_complex: This emoji is too complex. Pick another.
settings_media_relay: How voice and photos are sent
settings_media_relay_hint: Encrypted, then relayed. All the code is public.
settings_erase_hint: Can't be undone. Clears all data on this phone.
settings_erase_confirm_body: This can't be undone. All contacts, chats, and your identity will be erased.
action_ext_pairing_invite_body: Open {app} to add them as a contact
action_ext_manual_open_message: Saved to {app}. Please open {app} yourself to view it.
action_ext_manual_open_pairing: Handed to {app}. Please open {app} yourself to continue adding.
update_forced_body: This version is no longer supported. Please update to {version}.
update_failed_network: Download failed. Check your connection and retry.
update_failed_checksum: The downloaded package failed verification. Please retry.
update_permission_hint: To update, allow {app} to install apps on the next screen.
update_check_failed: Couldn't check for updates. Try again later.
invite_install_text: I'm sending you encrypted messages with {app}. Install it first: {link} (On Android you can also ask me for the app file.)
share_app_hint: Your friend opens the file to install. If it arrives as .apk.1 in a chat app, rename it or send the zip.
share_app_unavailable: This install can't be shared directly. Download it from the website instead.
about_what_title: Only your friend can read what you write
about_what_body: {app} is an end-to-end encrypted private messenger. Messages turn into ciphertext before they leave your device, and you send them through any chat app you already use. Anyone else only sees gibberish.
about_how_step1: Pair: scan face to face or send an invite code, then check that both screens show the same emoji.
about_how_step2: Write: type as usual in {app}. Sending gives you a piece of ciphertext.
about_how_step3: Deliver: share or paste it into any chat app. Your friend hands it to {app} and gets the original text.
about_safe_body: End-to-end encrypted, with keys that never leave your devices. Text never touches the network. The source is open for anyone to check.
paste_bar_read_failed: Couldn't read the clipboard. Long-press a text field to paste instead
conversations_empty_received_hint: Got an invite image? Long-press it and scan the QR code to add them

chats_pending_invites.other: {count} invites are waiting for a reply

name_prompt_hint: People see this when they add you

verify_later_banner: You can now compare the pictures together
thread_banner_say_hi: Send them a message — if they can open it, you're connected

pairing_mutual_invite: You both sent invites. You're already connected through theirs, so this one can be deleted
paste_bar_link_only: Only the link was copied. In your chat app, long-press the message, tap Select All, then copy
conversations_preview_waiting_peer: Waiting for them to finish adding you
